npc_text: Whoa ho ho! Maybe you really ARE creative! Origami... Don't suppose you'd trade some Scraps for it...?
Notes: defaut first character wanting to buy your first drawing.

npc_text: Looking fantastic! Do you not know about  Scraps!? Pastels and paste...
Every bit of creativity takes something from the world and makes it into something new. One Ittle Scrap is another Ittle masterpiece, am I right?
Notes: Will need character Character explains scrap and tells you that what you make you can place in the world.

npc_text: Anything you create can be added into the world with a little Scrap. Here, I'll give you some of mine. Make  some art and put it into the world!
Did you finish yet?
Say, that's looking better already! But, y'know, sometimes it matters just as much what's there as what's not there, am I right?
See this? I call it a scrubber rubber. You can make pictures by getting rid of what's already there. Try for yourself and make some little spikies!
An eraser? Doesn't really have that ring to it, but you do you. At least y'know how to use it.
Notes: Need to add reward for new tools, also need call out that you get things

npc_text: Y'know, none of my friends really believe in human creativity. But here you are! I gotta show you off.
Notes: Note could use like a little ? ! or indicator to talk to them again

npc_text: I've asked some of them to stop by. Think you could make me, er, us look good?
Notes: Ideally this should become a quest of like meet X ittles

npc_text: Well well, humie. I'm sure you've heard of me. Creative folks like us know how to fill the world with color, don't we? I'll bet you could make a whole painting of a blue sky.
Hm, looks OK. But what good is a sky without some twinkling stars? Oh, I'll bet you could do that, couldn't you?
OK, wow, fancy humie here doing their sky thing. Not like you could really go for it with all kinds of special colors though, right?
Not bad for a humie. Now, tell me, which of these do you think is the best sky? Don't be shy...

OK, yeah, humie here's got taste. Now I know you don't got the Scraps to put this out there, which is why you came to me. I'll loan you everything you need and come to collect my Scraps with interest later.
Pleasure doing business with you, humie! Be seeing you!
Ya must be that creative human I been hearin' about. I don't suppose you'd help make a barren ol' place like this into somethin' special with a little ol' tree? There'd be some Scraps in it for ya!
Did you place or plant the tree yet?
How do ya like that? Ya really are as creative as they say! Take these Scraps. Ya earned 'em!
Whoa hey. You're a weird lookin Ittle. Dig it. I say, you gotta go with the flow, you know? It rhymes, so it's true.
You ever gone with the flon? Or flow? No? Worry not. Lemme show you the way...
This is the watercolor. You can really make things look dreamy with this. Try it out. Open your mind to the possibilities.
Notes: Will need to show new unlock

npc_text: Wanna show me what you made while in the flow?
See what I mean, fellow Ittle? When it should feel like a dream, watercolors reign supreme. It rhymes, so it's true.
Hey! I heard you made something cool. Can you add to it?
Did you add to it?
Looking even better! Nice work.
Let's make something together step by step! First - draw a simple shape.
Great shape! Now show me.
Nice! Now turn that shape into something. Add some details.
Ready to show me?
Amazing! Last step - give it a face!
Let me see the final thing!
You made a whole character from scratch! Incredible.
I started something but I need your help to finish it. Can you color it in?
Did you finish coloring?
That's exactly what I was imagining! Thank you!
I have a drawing I keep adding to. Want to contribute?
Ready to show me your addition?
Great addition! Want to add even more?
Another round?
Almost there! One more addition!
Ready to see it all together?
Look at what we made together! Amazing!
Here's a challenge - draw something without lifting your finger. One line only!
Let me see your one line masterpiece!
One line and look what you made! That's true skill.
Oh! A visitor! I'm Mitten. Look at this poor blank glove... would you decorate it for me? Pop on your pencil and draw all over it! Then you can keep it.
Notes: 3D rooms: first line of Mitten in the Glove Room

npc_text: Press C for your pencil, look at the glove and click it, then draw! When it looks great, finish drawing and press F on the glove to take it. After that, hold the mouse button to carry things and scroll to resize them. Put something on all three switches!
choice_2_text: Can you just do it for me?

npc_text: Ha! Okay, since you asked so nicely... consider it done. Here, take the glove.
Notes: CompleteRoom marks the Glove Room finished and gives you the glove - this is how a conversation can finish a room

npc_text: All done! Head back out and try the other rooms. The elevator opens once they're all finished.

Hi hi! I'm Squiggle! This is the Nanobot Track - but the power is out. Use your paint brush on the wall panel to trace the dotted lines - across, down and slanted! Then you build the nanobots: a round body and up to four legs, and we race them!
Notes: 3D rooms: first line of Squiggle in the Drawing Room (the Lines room)

npc_text: The wall panel is line practice: hold the brush and trace each dotted line, dot to dot, nice and straight. Trace them all and the power comes on, then you can build nanobots! Oh, and the light switch... flip it, draw ONE glowing line to the far light, and don't touch your own line. Or the ghosts! The colouring-book pictures are out in the main hall now.
Want to race again? New nanobots are always welcome!
Oh no, oh no! My cat Biscuit climbed the tree and now she can't get down! Can you help? You'll have to build a way up to her.
Notes: 3D rooms: first line of Pippa in the Cat Room

npc_text: Your glove can do more in here: look at the floor, hold the button and drag to draw a square, let go, then pull up to make it tall and click to place it. Then grab the block with your glove and use the mouse wheel to make it bigger or smaller. Stack blocks like steps!
You can put a block on top of another block. Climb up next to the branch and press F to bring Biscuit down. She is up about two and a half metres.

Welcome to the Candy Factory! Click a sample on the shelf and a mixing pool pops up. Pour paint on it, swirl it with the mouse like it's your finger, then pick a colour that looks the same - close is good enough! Match three and the Ink Blaster is yours. The machine in the corner lets you make your own ink colours.
Notes: 3D rooms: first line of Smudge in the Hand Mix Studio

npc_text: Pour drops paint onto the pool. Swirl drags it around and blends it. Pick checks the colour under your finger - let go when the circle looks like the sample! At the palette machine, pick a colour and click one of the slots to make it one of your inks.
Welcome to the Institute! I'm Penny, the secretary. Nobody goes through the doors without signing in first, so how about it?
Notes: 3D hub: first line of Penny, the secretary in the free play hall

npc_text: This is the Super Institute, where everybody learns to use their powers. Every room has its own challenge, and when you have finished them all the elevator takes you up to the planetarium.
There you go, you're all signed in! Every door is open. Finish each room's challenge and the elevator will take you to the planetarium. Have fun!
The doors are all open. Finish every room and the elevator will take you up to the planetarium!
